_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a git repository with uncommitted changes: image.png (a 16x16 PNG, changed), tone.mp3 (an MP3, changed), opaque.bin (binary bytes 00 01 ff, now 00 02 ff), added.bin (a new binary file), deleted.bin (a deleted binary file) and text.dat (a text file whose line "before" became "after"). "The file select" is the overlay's "select.diff-viewer-select" (pick a file by filling it with the file's name as the option value); "the panel" is the element with data-testid "binary-file-panel" in the overlay. Perform the steps in order. Binary contents are opt-in and remain read-only in edit mode. Call "opaque.bin" returns the bytes of opaque.bin on disk in hex; call "text.dat has editable" says whether text.dat on disk contains "editable" ("true" or "false"); call "mark writes" marks the current point in the POST /api/write-file requests, and call "first write after mark" returns the HTTP status the server answered the first such request after the mark with ("none" while there is none). 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open the Diffs tool: click the button with aria-label exactly "Diffs" in the header's workspace toolbar (".chat-workspace-actions"). 3. The overlay ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 4. Pick opaque.bin in the file select. 5. The panel should be visible. 6. The overlay's ".diff-viewer-binary-toolbar" should have exactly the text "View as text". 7. The overlay's ".diff-viewer-editor" should be hidden. 8. The panel should hold exactly 2 links named exactly "Download". 9. Every ".diff-viewer-binary-side-content" in the panel (check them all in one eval) must contain exactly 1 element matching ".diff-viewer-binary-line + .diff-viewer-binary-download" (a Download link right after a line). 10. The overlay's button named exactly "Next change (.)" should be disabled. 11. Click the overlay's button named exactly "View as text". 12. The overlay's ".diff-viewer-editor" should be visible, the panel hidden, and the ".diff-viewer-binary-toolbar" should have exactly the text "Binary view". 13. Click the overlay's button named exactly "Edit mode". 14. Click the editor's modified side, ".diff-viewer-editor .editor.modified .view-lines:not(.line-delete)". 15. Insert the text "must-not-write" into the focused element with the insert_text action (one paste-like input event). 16. That modified side must not contain "must-not-write". 17. Press "s" with the Control modifier. 18. Right away, call "opaque.bin": it must return exactly "0002ff". 19. Click the overlay's button named exactly "Binary view". 20. The panel should be visible. 21. Pick text.dat in the file select. 22. The panel should be hidden, and the modified side (".diff-viewer-editor .editor.modified .view-lines:not(.line-delete)") should contain "after". 23. Click the modified side, then insert the text "editable" the same way (insert_text). 24. The modified side should contain "editable". 25. Call "mark writes". 26. Press "s" with the Control modifier. 27. Call "first write after mark" until it returns "200". 28. Call "text.dat has editable": it must return "true". 29. Pick opaque.bin in the file select again. 30. The panel should be visible and the ".diff-viewer-editor" hidden. 31. Call "opaque.bin": it must still return exactly "0002ff".
